## Konkurrencen er blevet aflyst af WCA bestyrelsen på grund af at Danmarks corona-smittetal er over 500.

Maksimum **1 gæst** per deltager!
Se [denne fane](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HvidovreSummerTwinB2021#15349-corona-forholdsregler-precautions) for de  **forholdsregler** der skal tages.

Dette er en tvillingekonkurrence. Se [denne fane](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HvidovreSummerTwinB2021#15366-tvillingekonkurrence-twin-competition) for mere information.
___
## The competition has been cancelled by the WCA Board because Denmark's daily COVID infections is over 500.

Maximum **1 guest** per competitor!
See [this tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HvidovreSummerTwinB2021#15349-corona-forholdsregler-precautions) for the  **precautions** which have to be taken during the competition.

This is a twin competition. See [this tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HvidovreSummerTwinB2021#15366-tvillingekonkurrence-twin-competition) for more information.
